args.sql: SELECT reckey, log_ts FROM shipments LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    s.reckey AS shipment_code,
    MAX(COALESCE((em.env_metrics->'light_and_shock'->>'shock_event_count')::int, 0)) AS max_shock_value
FROM shipments s
LEFT JOIN environmentalmonitoring em ON s.reckey = em.reckeylink
GROUP BY s.reckey
ORDER BY s.reckey
LIMIT 10;

    s.reckey AS shipment_code,

GROUP BY s.reckey
HAVING MAX(COALESCE((em.env_metrics->'light_and_shock'->>'shock_event_count')::int, 0)) = 0
